collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A child hides behind a stack of baskets during a game of seek-and-find.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), a child, hides behind a stack of baskets during a game of seek-and-find. The seeker walks right past three times without noticing.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), a child, hides behind a stack of baskets during a game of seek-and-find. A giggle gives the hiding place away.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), a child, hides behind a stack of baskets during a game of seek-and-find. The baskets topple, and the child is found surrounded by spilled roots.

e4__fx.name: Ending 4
e4__fx.text: (Name1), a child, hides behind a stack of baskets during a game of seek-and-find. The child waits so long that the seeker gives up, and the child emerges in triumph.

e4__text.text: (Name1), a child, hides behind a stack of baskets during a game of seek-and-find. The child waits so long that the seeker gives up, and the child emerges in triumph.
